DIAGNOSTIC_note: measured, not asserted. These are float candidate values read out of committed artifacts, not certified bounds, and nothing in the gate or the certificate depends on them. They are recorded because they decide whether any route could discharge cell 308, and the honest answer is that none can.

L_ladder_Wald.assumptions: frozen CUSUM geometry; K > 0; start at the atom; E[tau] < infinity (Lemma T)
L_ladder_Wald.domain: any single drift e in the closed cell; evaluated at e_lo
L_ladder_Wald.existing_inputs: K, H from the pinned frozen producer; e_lo from the cover ledger
L_ladder_Wald.note: uses no Arb certificate, no registry constant and no candidate polynomial, so it is independent of every surface C2 and C3 argued about
L_ladder_Wald.theorem: E_a[tau] >= H / E[(|z| - K)^+] (c4_lower_bound.py, theorem L)

R1_taboo_defect_inversion.existing_inputs: the committed taboo candidate payload w and the frozen certifier
R1_taboo_defect_inversion.preference_class: direct transformation of an existing certified bound
R1_taboo_defect_inversion.status: REJECTED: needs a new operator certification, and cannot change the verdict on 308
R1_taboo_defect_inversion.theorem: w = Ghat 1 + Ghat g with g := w - 1 - Khat w >= 0, and (Ghat g)(a) <= tau_a sup g, so tau_a >= w(a) / (1 + sup_X g); then E_a[tau] >= that / D_mid_hi
R1_taboo_defect_inversion.why: the certifier records inf_X of the defect (margin_lower_bound) but discards sup_X, which is the quantity this route needs; obtaining it is a re-run of certify_block, i.e. a new operator certification, and python-flint is not present on this host

R2_whole_kernel_defect_inversion.preference_class: direct transformation of an existing certified bound
R2_whole_kernel_defect_inversion.status: REJECTED: the committed whole-kernel proposal is shifted (beta = 2), so sup G is at least 2 sup h_1 and the bound is strictly weaker than R1
R2_whole_kernel_defect_inversion.theorem: E_a[tau] >= Abar / (1 + sup_X G), G := W - 1 - K W

R3_truncated_neumann.status: REJECTED: n kernel applications per cell, i.e. a new operator computation, with no advantage over R1

R4_reuse_only.note: the only strictly-reuse route; reported with its numbers rather than dismissed
R4_reuse_only.theorem: E_a[tau] = tau_a / D >= 1 / D, with tau_a >= 1 and D from D_mid's upper end

R5_two_sided_tau_certificate.status: REJECTED HERE, RECOMMENDED TO A SUCCESSOR: sharpest of all, but it is a new Chebyshev fit plus a new Arb certification, and it still cannot discharge 308
R5_two_sided_tau_certificate.theorem: a candidate t with |t - 1 - Khat t| <= eps gives tau_a in [t(a)/(1+eps), t(a)/(1-eps)]
